title: Canonical incoming-alpha image lift to a finite derived-D term
statement:
Let $X$ be a type-zero bigraded exact couple in an abelian category [def-sp-exact-couple]. Fix integers $a,p,q$ with $p\geq0$. Put $R=\max(p+3,q-a+2)$, $r=R-2$, $u=p-r$, $v=q+r$. Let $\iota_n:D_n^{i,j}\to D^{i,j}$ be the recursively composed canonical derived-D inclusions, with $\iota_0=1$. Let $F$ be a decreasing filtration of $D^{0,p+q}$ [def-sp-filtration] whose steps at every $i\geq0$ are the images of the incoming $i$-fold alpha iterate [def-sp-convergence]. Suppose the specified map $\lambda:D^{0,p+q}\to D^{u,v}$ equals the canonically transported outgoing $(-u)$-fold alpha iterate and is invertible. Then there is an invertible map $\ell:F^p\to D_r^{u,v}$ with $\iota_r\circ\ell=\lambda\circ(F^p\hookrightarrow D^{0,p+q})$. No support or vanishing assumption is required.

Exact Lean interface:
```lean
theorem finitePage_image_lift
    {B : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} B] [Abelian B]
    (X : BigradedExactCouple B 0) (a : ℤ)
    (inc : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (X.pageCouple r).D p q ⟶ X.D p q)
    (hinc0 : ∀ p q : ℤ, inc 0 p q = 𝟙 _)
    (hinc : ∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), inc (r + 1) p q =
      (X.pageCouple r).derivedDInclusion p q ≫ inc r p q)
    (p q : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (X.D 0 (p + q)))
    (hF : ∀ i : ℤ, 0 ≤ i → F.step i =
      imageSubobject (X.incomingAlphaIter i.toNat 0 (p + q)))
    (lambda : X.D 0 (p + q) ⟶
      X.D (p - max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) + 2) (q + max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) - 2))
    (hlambda : lambda = X.alphaIter
      (-(p - max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) + 2)).toNat 0 (p + q) ≫
        eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega))
    [IsIso lambda] :
    ∃ (lift : (F.step p : B) ⟶
        (X.pageCouple ((max (p + 3) (q - a + 2)).toNat - 2)).D
          (p - max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) + 2)
          (q + max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) - 2)),
      IsIso lift ∧
      lift ≫ inc ((max (p + 3) (q - a + 2)).toNat - 2)
          (p - max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) + 2)
          (q + max (p + 3) (q - a + 2) - 2) = (F.step p).arrow ≫ lambda
```

proof.text: Use pageCouple_image from [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact]. Its A and I families are uniquely specified by their initial values and recurrences. Expand incomingAlphaIter using alphaIter and compare the endpoint transports to prove its successor recurrence. Natural-number induction identifies A with incomingAlphaIter and I with inc. Therefore inc is monomorphic and its image is the incoming iterate image.

Induct on the first length to prove alphaIter(m+n) is the composite of the m-fold iterate and the n-fold iterate at its endpoint, as a heterogeneous equality. The successor step uses associativity and removal of the canonical equality transports. Since r>=p, split the r-fold incoming iterate after p steps at first index zero, identifying the remaining iterate with lambda.

Precomposition by the source equality isomorphism does not change the incoming image. Factor the incoming p-fold iterate through its image, and use the epimorphic image projection to compute its image after lambda. The filtration formula identifies this image with that of F.step(p).arrow followed by lambda. Both this composite and inc are mono; Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk gives lift, and its defining commutative square gives the required equation.
